dog.description_text:
Hi! Im Sunny - my foster family calls me Sunny Marie. People say I’m gentle and sweet - and it’s true! I’m the kind of girl that will always be at your side. All I want is to be around people! I might be a little clingy, but that’s just because I like spending time with you. Cuddling is probably my favorite hobby.

I love meeting new friends - people, dogs, cats, you name it! I don’t bark at others - My love language is sniffing.

I’ve got some silly habits too, which you’ll uncover the more you spend time with me.

There’s much much more to know about me - reach out to see !

Some other stuff about me:

Personality & Characteristics: Total love bug! Gentle and sweet, loves being in the company of others. Super silly and quirky :)

My foster dog is good with: Dogs, Cats, and Kids!

My foster dog is: Low shed and house trained. Crate training in progress

3 Keywords for your pup: gentle, sweet, quirky

Energy Level (1= calm, 10= high energy): 5

Barker? Or Quiet Pup?: Quiet until left alone - still working on crate training

Walking Manners: Not a puller ! Still working on staying in a direct path/ not getting distracted - nose to the ground sniffer!

Appetite: Loves meal time! Still figuring out what treats are

Favorite Things: Sniffing everything in sight, meeting new friends, and cuddling on the couch!

Commands/Tricks: Still working on them :)

ALL adoptions require a completed application and final contract. The application can be found at WaldosRescue.org and once you are approved to adopt you will be put in touch with the foster to see if it’s a good match. We are a RESCUE not a shelter. We conduct veterinary and personal reference checks during the application approval process. We are unable to contact every applicant for every dog. We will select the best applicant for each dog, based on the dogs needs. Waldos Rescue Pen is a 501c3 whose primary focus is rescuing dogs from the euthanasia list from high kill shelters throughout the United States and Korea.
dog.name: Sunrise (Sunny)
